turn: I added `parseLock` in `src/pluginlock/parse.ts`, which turns lockfile text into a list of `LockEntry` objects. It splits the text on newlines, drops blank lines, and reads each line as a space-separated name, version and integrity value. I haven't run it or any tests. I only reread the code against the `LockEntry` type from `format.js`, so the behavior is unchecked. As written, a malformed line with fewer than three fields would give undefined values instead of an error. In the same commit I made one small unrelated fix I noticed along the way: I corrected a wrong import path in the plugin lockfile module so it resolves to the right file. Next I will start "Plugin lockfile writer".

sidefix.title: Correct wrong lockfile import path
sidefix.what: Fixed an import path in the plugin lockfile module that pointed at the wrong file.
